issues.title: Cracked or Shattered Glass

issues.title: Unresponsive or Ghost-Touch Screens
issues.text: If your screen doesn’t respond to taps, or starts acting on its own, it’s often a sign of internal screen damage. We’ll install a fresh screen and restore smooth, accurate touch function.

issues.title: Flickering, Discoloured or Black Displays
issues.text: Flickering images, green lines, faded colours or no display at all can result from impact or internal screen faults. We’ll diagnose and replace the screen right where you are.

issues.title: Lines, Spots or Screen Distortion
issues.text: If you see vertical lines, black dots, or parts of your display are missing - the screen likely needs replacement. We’ll sort it on the spot with no downtime.

issues.title: Unexpected Shutdowns or Restarts
issues.text: iPhones that switch off at 30%, 50% or while idle typically have ageing or unstable batteries. We’ll replace it with a reliable, high-performance part and test functionality on-site.

issues.title: Overheating or Swelling
issues.text: If your iPhone gets hot during charging or use, or if the screen looks slightly lifted, the battery could be damaged or swollen. This can be dangerous - we’ll safely remove it and install a replacement.
